Features

Everything a kitchen designer needs

SG Kitchen PRO is built on SketchUp's Dynamic Components system, so every cabinet you place is parametric and fully adjustable without regenerating.

Fully dynamic cabinets

Every dimension is a live parameter. Change width, height, depth, or material in the Component Options panel and the cabinet updates instantly — no rebuilding required.

Animating doors & drawers

Click any door or drawer in your model to animate it open and closed. Solid slab and 5-piece glass shaker styles are both supported with correct hinge pivoting.

Smart snap placement

Auto-snap any new cabinet to the left or right of a selected one with a single click. Builds complete kitchen runs in seconds without manual alignment.

CSV cut list export

Generate a complete bill of materials from your entire kitchen layout with one click. Exports part name, quantity, length, width, and thickness ready for the workshop.

Global master settings

Set standard dimensions and materials once in the Global Settings panel and push them to every cabinet type simultaneously — great for switching between imperial and metric projects.

Machine-locked licensing

Licenses are bound to your specific machine. No subscription servers, no internet connection required after activation. Your key works offline, forever.

Cabinet library

16 cabinet types, ready to place

From a basic straight base to specialty stemware racks and diagonal corners — the full library has every run covered.

Workflow

From dialog to placed cabinet in three steps

No complex setup. Just click a toolbar button, fill in your dimensions, and place.

1

Open the dialog

Click any cabinet type in the SG Kitchen PRO toolbar. A clean dialog opens with all configurable parameters — dimensions, material, door style, shelf count.

2

Configure & build

Set your width, height, depth, and door style. Hit Build. The dynamic component is assembled with correct parametric formulas in under a second.

3

Place or snap

Click to place manually, or use Smart Snap to automatically drop the new cabinet flush against a selected one — left or right aligned, at the correct Z height.

4

Adjust any time

Select any cabinet and open Component Options to live-edit any dimension. Doors, drawers, shelves, and materials all update with zero rebuilding.

FAQ

Common questions

Which versions of SketchUp does this work with?
SG Kitchen PRO is compatible with SketchUp 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026 on both Windows and macOS. It requires Ruby 3.x, which is included in all modern SketchUp versions.
Can I transfer my license to a new computer?
Yes. Deactivate the license on your old machine via Extensions → SG Kitchen PRO → Deactivate License. Then send your new Machine ID to us and we'll issue a fresh key for your new PC at no extra charge.
Does the plugin require an internet connection to work?
No. After initial activation, the plugin runs entirely offline. License validation is done locally against your machine fingerprint — no server calls required.
Are the cabinets compatible with SketchUp's Dynamic Components extension?
Yes, they are built on top of Dynamic Components. You can use the native Component Options panel (Window → Component Options) to modify any parameter, and the built-in DC Interact tool to animate doors and drawers.
How do I get my activation key after purchase?
After payment, open SketchUp and go to Extensions → SG Kitchen PRO → Copy Machine ID. Email that code along with your purchase email to us at sketchupgurus@gmail.com. We'll send your unique 16-character key within 24 hours.
What file formats can I export from the cut list?
The cut list is exported as a CSV file that opens in any spreadsheet application — Excel, Google Sheets, LibreOffice Calc. It includes cabinet type, part name, quantity, length, width, and thickness for every visible component in the selection.
